title: Preview selected authorized supplier purchase exposure fields
description: A purchasing user selects finite purchase-order exposure fields and filters for a current-page read-only preview. Development only. Reuse ERP-031 SupplierPurchaseExposure.ForQueryAsync, its supplier/currency/date/link-status filters and bounded page; recheck the current user's purchase-order menu for every request, fail closed on missing permission and invalid filters, and use existing HTTP operation audit. Keep linked settlement evidence separate from ambiguous/unavailable references, preserve null unknown amounts and original currencies, and state this is not accounts payable or payment authority. No arbitrary SQL, migration, production SQL, real database execution, writes, secrets/.env change or deployment. Verify focused tests and safe Release build/test; no real-browser acceptance.
acceptance_criteria: Authenticated catalog and preview expose only a finite order-evidence field allowlist; reject unknown columns, bad supplier/currency/date/link filters and page size above 200 before source reads.

Preview checks current-user purchase-order menu, reuses SupplierPurchaseExposure.ForQueryAsync and projects only selected current-page order fields in requested order, retaining null unknown settlement/receipt values and currency isolation.
Unit tests cover allowed and denied users, filters, selected order, link ambiguity, unknown values, paging and no writes; document exposure and payable boundaries.
